sc_cat_item_producer.description:
Training Enrollment.

Use this form to request enrollment in one of the available training sessions. Your manager will review and approve your participation before the session begins. Please select a valid schedule and mure sure all information is accurate before submitting your request.

 

Note: All fields are required.

 

Tips

• You can only enroll in available sessions.

• You can enroll in the same course up to 3 times only.

• Enrollments are accepted to one day before the training date.

• Duplicated requests for the same session will be automatically rejected
